title: Which Shelves?
story: How many different categories does the market sell? Repeats make the list long.
goal: List each category once, in alphabetical order.

tests.label: Hidden check on other data
Hidden check on other data

hints: DISTINCT removes repeated rows from the result.
Add ORDER BY category at the end to sort A to Z.
SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products ORDER BY category;
socratic: Why does the plain query repeat names?
Compare the rows you got with the rows expected. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what does your query do?
solution: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products ORDER BY category;
alt: SELECT category FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category;
